key_insight: StepRS-GRPO makes reinforcement learning for diffusion LLMs more effective by adjusting risk sensitivity across denoising steps, improving both accuracy and answer diversity on math reasoning tasks.
engineering_relevance: For practitioners building dLLM training pipelines, the method offers a drop-in way to better allocate learning signal over generation states without changing the underlying GRPO trainer.
method: Vary the risk coefficient of the group-advantage transform across denoising states.
Use a capability-based calibration to set the coefficient scale.
Test endpoint and interpolation schedules, while keeping the core RLVR/GRPO framework unchanged.
evidence_signal: Across multiple dLLM backbones and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, StepRS-GRPO improves pass@1 and pass@k over centered GRPO, with ablations showing gains persist after RMS-matching and diversity increases in reasoning traces.
watch_item: Performance depends on the chosen state-wise schedule and calibration, so careful tuning is needed to avoid gains coming from a poorly matched risk allocation.
paper_title: Exploring More, Reasoning Better: Stepwise Risk-Sensitive GRPO for Diffusion Language Models
